scope.reviewed: main body and two leaves, threshold/counter/reset/blend control flow, exact data accesses, return and frame preservation

findings.result: Independent decode confirms all three exact spans: main [4FEE,5054), zero leaf [4DB4,4DB8), and reset leaf [4DB8,4DC4). The zero leaf returns 0; the main retains that status and returns it. Sample>=baseline clears byte7. The 32-bit baseline+parameter28 comparison selects byte-counter increment or reset; reset clears fraction byte8, copies sample into baseline, then clears counter.

The other branch freshly reads context word0/header byte40. With header zero and sample strictly above baseline+parameter26 it skips blending; otherwise it calls 4FDE with sample<<8, (baseline<<8)|fraction, and byte34 weight, then stores the returned high portion to baseline and low byte to fraction. Item halfword4 and remaining item bytes are untouched. R4-R7/SP restore.

All 5,184 original-instruction fixtures passed in isolated execution and replay JSON is byte-identical. The source, all three exact code spans and receipt-listed artifacts hash-check. The fixture matrix uses equal parameter values at offsets 26 and 28, so it does not independently test those two thresholds diverging.

limitations: Threshold parameters at offsets 26 and 28 are equal in all fixtures; their independent relationship is not tested.
Fixtures use separate static synthetic allocations; physical meaning, aliasing, concurrent mutation and caller closure remain unresolved.
No canonical admission or C implementation.
